description: PUMS - Progetto - Accessibilità ciclopedonale da stazioni ferroviarie - Città Metropolitana di Firenze is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappe.cittametropolitana.fi.it. The Sustainable Urban Mobility Plan (SUMP) is the strategic document that aims to guide urban mobility policies for the next 10 years.Accessibility is the ability to access places in the city where activities of interest and destinations are located that you want to reach.In this dataset we find the road arches reachable within 1500m, 2000m ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PUMS - Project - Pedestrian access from railway stations - Metropolitan City of Florence" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include geodata, PUMS, opendata. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
